claude-a.prompt:
REFERENCES: Image 1 is the character sheet of Xiao Ke (Claude). Redraw THIS SAME character with the same face and the same outfit design, but render her in the art style described below. The reference's soft painterly shading must become flat cel shading.
CHARACTER: Xiao Ke. A young woman, calm and gentle, with a faint smile and warm amber eyes. Very long straight orange hair with a few loose strands. An orange chrysanthemum-like flower hair ornament with a black ribbon on one side, and a tassel earring. A high ruffled collar with a black cravat and an orange flower brooch, a cream capelet, a black corset belt with a thin gold chain, a long layered cream / black / orange skirt, and white lace-up heeled boots. She carries her dark red-brown leather book.
ACCENT COLOUR FAMILY: warm orange (#D97757 to #F0A070) for the hair, flower ornaments and the orange skirt panel. The book is a dark red-brown. Everything else is neutral (cream, greys, black).
POSE: full body, standing, three-quarter view facing slightly to the left. She holds the book against her chest with one arm. The other hand is relaxed and slightly open, as if about to reach out to someone. The whole figure is visible from the top of the hair to the boots.

ds-1:
CHARACTER: 'DeepSeek', an original anime girl who personifies a deep-sea blue whale. A young woman, a little shorter than average, earnest and polite, with gentle, slightly sleepy eyes and a faint shy blush. No animal ears. No text, no logos, no letters anywhere.
ACCENT COLOUR FAMILY: DeepSeek blue (#4D6BFE) through deep navy (#1B2A6B) and pale periwinkle (#A9B8FF), for the hair, eyes and accent parts of the outfit. Everything else is neutral (white, greys, near-black).
DESIGN: very long, voluminous, softly wavy blue hair whose lower part turns deep navy with a hard-edged colour step. One curled ahoge shaped like a little whale water-spout. A small white whale-tail hair clip. The outfit is a modest navy-and-white dress inspired by a classic maid uniform: long sleeves with white cuffs, a high white collar, a calf-length navy skirt with a white frilled hem, and a white apron whose waist bow is shaped like a whale's tail flukes. A white frilled headband, white tights and navy Mary-Jane shoes. A slim navy fountain pen is clipped to her collar.
POSE: full body, standing, three-quarter view facing slightly to the right, hands clasped in front of her chest, looking at the viewer politely. The whole figure is visible from the top of the ahoge to the shoes.
